svg.title: Setting targets: parse, then update the saved targets

g.text: Setting targets: parse, then update the saved targets
[blank, unknown or repeated prefix, or invalid value]
Parsing stops before any command exists, so the saved targets are unchanged.
Dispatch on the command word and logging are condensed. The recipe book passed to execute
is not used, and ActiveMealPlan is not involved, so an existing plan keeps its own targets.
